dict.string: mpia needs Contacts access to read and manage your iCloud contacts from the local CLI.
mpia needs full Calendar access to query and explicitly manage events in your iCloud calendars.
mpia needs full Reminders access to query and explicitly manage reminders in your iCloud lists.
mpia needs Photos access to query photo and album metadata and to export only explicitly requested assets.
mpia uses Apple Events only for explicitly requested Mail.app, Notes.app, Shortcuts, and Safari operations.
